name: GhostInlineAlert
description: Inline contextual feedback with optional live-region semantics. useGhostInlineAlert supplies root bindings; GhostInlineAlert renders title, message, and actions slots.

props.name: announce
props.description:
Live-region behavior. Default `off` for static inline feedback.
Use `status` or `alert` only when copy appears or changes after mount.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. Prefer `div` inside table cells.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Optional action controls such as GhostButton. Children stay focusable.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Optional heading. Rendered as h1–h6 from headingLevel.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Root element after mount; null before mount.

keyboard.Tab: Moves through focusable content in the actions slot. The root is not focusable.
